About this item

  • Sip Faster, Spill Less: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is designed for quick hydration. Just flip up to sip and snap it shut for a leak resistant seal. Perfect for your bag, commute, or workout.
  • Cold for 20 Hours, Iced for Days: Stay refreshed wherever you go Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps your drink cold for 20 hours or iced for up to 3 days, so you can hydrate longer without refills.
  • Upgraded for On-the-Go: This tumbler is built for life in motion with an easy-carry handle and cupholder-compatible base. Whether you're running errands or heading to the gym, hydration is always within reach.
  • Durable, Sustainable, and Easy to Clean: Made with 18/8 recycled stainless steel, this BPA-free tumbler is tough enough for everyday use and dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning.
  • Designed for Convenience: The removable spout and replaceable seal make cleaning and maintenance a breeze, so your tumbler stays fresh and functional for years to come.

Product Description

Now in recycled stainless steel, get sustainable hydration on the go with the IceFlow 2.0 Tumbler. Ready to toss in your bag, it slips right into your car cupholder. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid lets you hydrate faster and stays leak resistant when closed. The IceFlow 2.0 Tumbler with Flip Straw 2.0 Lid has a wider opening and built-in straw for quick sipping. Just flip up to drink, then snap shut when you’re done. Thanks to double-wall vacuum insulation, your drink stays cold for hours. A large easy-carry handle is ready to grab and take along for the day.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Exceeds all expectations. You can pay more & get less.
I waited a full week before writing this review, to test this and live with it a bit. I'd read so many reviews of different products of this Type- Including YETI, HydroFlask, etc. About 20 months ago, I'd bought a few Zojirushi water bottles as stocking stuffers for my wife and I- having already been-through a few other brands and types that ultimately didn't gain favor or last. And sadly, the Zojirushi though well-rated was similarly destined to replacement for various reasons I won't list here, but it was loud in its operation (think you want a quiet drink at 3am without waking your significant other, nope) and didn't "drink from" well, if that makes sense. Yeti- I was set to spring for them....but meh. More "Brand/Status identity" than actual performance & substance IMO...and overpriced because of that. And so forth. I am truly a buy-once, cry-once person; but I also understand VALUE. It's not always 'the most expensive' that is the best...and this Water Tumbler is a prime example of that. Ladies and Gentlemen, I introduce the Stanley IceFlow 2.0 Flip straw number. I've finally found the right water tumbler. Made by STANLEY- industry standard for years and I know it's more a utilitarian "brand" and not fashionable, but IT DELIVERS... and I could not be more exuberant over such a simple item. It handles well, travels well, & for me, the 30oz is just the sight size for overall day to day travel and errands, it hasn't leaked, temperature retention is EXCELLENT and it's well-made. I like the carry handle which tilts out of the way, but is robust enough for daily use without the concern over it breaking due to cheap manufacturing. And in its function- it's QUIET!!!! Flip the flip-straw spigot up and it quietly does so and just a quietly flips back into its sealed position. No waking the spouse at 3am with a click-click or other obnoxious noises that seemingly are amplified in the wee quiet hours of sleep time. This is important for me/us. lol I wasn't sure I'd like the straw-oriented setup, and I absolutely LOVE IT. Simple to manipulate the spigot, even when driving, if need be. The straw removes easy for easy cleaning, the entire tumbles is easily cleaned ( I hand-wash mine only) but it's dishwasher safe, BPA-Free (!!), and the size of the straw allows you to draw a good volume of water. And quietly. Now the finish- first, I chose the ASH color so as to not draw heat like darker colors will, and shows less handling smudges or gunk. BUT THE TEXTURE IS DA-BOMB!!! It's perfect for traction/grip, but not too coarse to draw unwanted oils and dirt AND it seems to be resistant to mars & scratches. I had an armful of shopping bags a few days ago and my car keys and gripping the side of the tumbler (not the handle in this instance) in the other hand, as my wife and I came home from the grocery store- and I'm thinking "okay those car-key edges are chafing the side of the mug and I'll probably have scratches on it"....not a single one. Nothing. So robust. Now I'm sure if I were to kick it down a gravel driveway that might be a different story, but you get the idea. The finish & material overall, is QUALITY. I'm seriously thinking of getting one or two more of these in different colors just for the "mood" that I may be in at the moment...lol, but honestly, this simple water tumbler has been the most surprising Amazon purchase I've made in a long time...maybe THE most. UPDATE 8/16/26: I put a handful of ice cubes into this tumbler last night before bed and filled it with water. As of right at at 6pm the following evening, the water in the tumbler is still cold enough to give you a brain freeze. Seriously. If that's not well-insulated, I don't know what is. (end of update) THIS IS AN EPIC WIN, and a must-have.

    Performance & Insulation:The Stanley IceFlow 2.0 Flip Straw Tumbler is a standout for anyone who needs their water to stay cold during long shifts or outdoor activities. Thanks to the double-wall vacuum insulation, it keeps drinks chilled for up to 12 hours and iced for a staggering 2 days. Unlike the popular Quencher, this model is designed specifically for cold liquids, making it incredibly efficient at maintaining temperature without the bulk of a multi-purpose lid.Design & Portability:One of the best features of the 20 oz size is its tapered base, which fits perfectly in standard car cup holders. The integrated folding handle makes it much easier to carry while walking or commuting compared to side-handle models. It’s also built with sustainability in mind, using recycled stainless steel and materials sourced from discarded fishing nets, so it feels as good to use as it looks.The Flip Straw Advantage:The leakproof flip straw is the highlight of the design. When snapped shut, you can toss this tumbler into a backpack or gym bag without worrying about a single drop escaping. The built-in straw allows for quick, upright sipping, which is much safer and more convenient while driving or exercising than tilting a traditional bottle. It’s also fully dishwasher safe, and the newer 2.0 version features a removable spout for even deeper cleaning.Verdict:If you want the durability and style of a Stanley but need something that is truly portable and leakproof, the IceFlow Flip Straw is the superior choice. It’s rugged, easy to carry, and fits into a busy, on-the-go lifestyle perfectly. A 5-star essential for anyone from students to outdoor enthusiasts.

About this Item

  • Sip Faster, Spill Less: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is designed for quick hydration. Just flip up to sip and snap it shut for a leak resistant seal. Perfect for your bag, commute, or workout.
  • Cold for 20 Hours, Iced for Days: Stay refreshed wherever you go Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps your drink cold for 20 hours or iced for up to 3 days, so you can hydrate longer without refills.
  • Upgraded for On-the-Go: This tumbler is built for life in motion with an easy-carry handle and cupholder-compatible base. Whether you're running errands or heading to the gym, hydration is always within reach.
  • Durable, Sustainable, and Easy to Clean: Made with 18/8 recycled stainless steel, this BPA-free tumbler is tough enough for everyday use and dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning.
  • Designed for Convenience: The removable spout and replaceable seal make cleaning and maintenance a breeze, so your tumbler stays fresh and functional for years to come.

Product Description

Now in recycled stainless steel, get sustainable hydration on the go with the IceFlow 2.0 Tumbler. Ready to toss in your bag, it slips right into your car cupholder. The Flip Straw 2.0 lid lets you hydrate faster and stays leak resistant when closed. The IceFlow 2.0 Tumbler with Flip Straw 2.0 Lid has a wider opening and built-in straw for quick sipping. Just flip up to drink, then snap shut when you’re done. Thanks to double-wall vacuum insulation, your drink stays cold for hours. A large easy-carry handle is ready to grab and take along for the day.
